main_text.l: MAGNENTIVS, Comes duorum ordinum Augustæ
(vrbs est Germaniæ) cōuiuiū militibus exhibuit, à mane ad ve-
speram, more gentis. inde in cubiculū ingressus, statim egres-
sus est, indutus purpura, ac multis satellitibus cinctus: qui cōscij
non erat, coacti sunt assentiri: donatiuum dedit, posuitq; custo-
des ne quis rem aperiret. deinde cum lectissimis Gaisone mit-
tit, qui Constantem in tentorio occidit, anno mundi 4313. à
Christo nato 351. Hic Cæsare facit Decentium fratrem, mit-
titq; cum exercitu vti Gallias tueatur iamq; tota Italia: & Afri-
ca Magnentij erant. Constātius tunc in Oriente aduersam for-
tunam cōtra Persas experiebatur: ad quē legatos misit cum li-
teris, vti Oriēte & Thraciis cōtentus esset: qui nihil respondet,
sed Gallum patruelem Cæsarē faciēs, eum in Oriēte relinquit:
ipse Hesperios adit, vlturus fratris cædē. attamen ne sua Roma
bello vexaretur ciuili Gallia Magnentio permittit, si arma de-
ponat: Tyrānus sperans vincere, non paruit. pugnatur ad Mur-
sam, magnis vtrinque viribus: vincitur Magnentius: bellū repa-
rat: victus iterum, tandem gladio occultè prouisso mortem sibi
consciscit. Pom. Læ. in Constāte. Aurel. Victo. Hic Desiderium
fratrem per furorem vulnerauit, & quosdam ex amicis occidit,
paulò ante quàm seipsum occideret.
DECENTIVS qui Gallias tuebatur, audito fratris sui
Magnentij casu, laqueo apud Senonas vitam finiuit, sibi me-
tuens. horum frater Desiderius Constantiū adiit, à quo huma-
nissimè exceptus est anno mundi 4316. à Christo nato 354.
Pomp. Læt. Aurel. Vict.

page.notes: Two coin portraits (illustrations, not text): left reads "D N MAGNENTIVS P F AVG", right reads "D N DECENTIVS NOB CAES". Small specks near the text are not printed text. Printing errors left as printed: "Gaisone", "Constātius" spelled as printed. Heading styling: the opening words "MAGNENTIVS" and "DECENTIVS" are in capitals and set apart; the first is larger, so it is shown as a line-leading heading with the rest of the paragraph text inside it. The first paragraph was set as a single block in the scan; its later paragraph break is not visible, so it is kept as one paragraph.
